repository.description: AngularJS — HTML enhanced for web apps!

evidence_packet.readme_excerpt: AngularJS support has officially ended as of January 2022.

evidence.claim: Days since the last recorded push

analysis.epitaph: AngularJS helped reshape client-side development; its archived repository now preserves both that legacy and the unfinished work around it.

findings.finding: The repository is intentionally preserved in an archived state.
uncertainties: The archive flag alone does not explain every factor behind the decision.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve the evidence before experimenting in a fork.

findings.finding: Development activity declined before the final recorded push.
uncertainties: A sampled timeline may omit activity outside the retrieved history.
findings.recommended_action: Reconstruct the last supported toolchain in an isolated environment.

findings.finding: Substantial unresolved work remains visible to potential contributors.
uncertainties: The issue count does not prove that each report remains reproducible.
findings.recommended_action: Triage one well-scoped issue and document whether it still reproduces.

resurrection_plan.title: Snapshot the surviving evidence
resurrection_plan.action: Fork the repository and record licensing, releases, and installation notes.

resurrection_plan.title: Rebuild the historical toolchain
resurrection_plan.action: Map the last supported Node.js and package-manager versions without changing source.

resurrection_plan.title: Prove one clean baseline
resurrection_plan.action: Run reviewed checks in isolation and record the first deterministic failure.

resurrection_plan.title: Choose one bounded recovery target
resurrection_plan.action: Select a reproducible issue with a small, testable outcome.

resurrection_plan.title: Publish a contributor brief
resurrection_plan.action: Document compatibility findings, risks, and the smallest useful contribution.
